reconnectHint claude-code: After signing in, connect this account: claude mcp add --transport http graffiticode https://mcp.graffiticode.org/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <api-key>" — the sign-in page issues the key.
reconnectHint editor: After signing in, add an Authorization: Bearer <api-key> header to the graffiticode entry in your MCP config — the sign-in page issues the key.
reconnectHint codex-cli: After signing in, connect this account: run codex mcp login graffiticode (use the name codex mcp list shows), sign in with the same account, then restart Codex.
reconnectHint claude-app: After signing in, connect this account: in Claude, open Settings → Connectors, disconnect Graffiticode and connect it again, then sign in with the same account.
reconnectHint openai: New items will keep starting out anonymous, so save each one with the link above; the sign-in page explains how to connect this connector to your account.
reconnectHint unknown: The sign-in page also shows how to connect your agent so new items save automatically.
buildLinkDirective mounted: The item is displayed above in the Graffiticode view. Reply with one short sentence about it (from `summary`) and give the user this link to open it: https://app.example/form/x. Do not reproduce its contents — no tables, lists or mock-ups; the view already shows them. A description alone is not a substitute for the link.
buildLinkDirective unmounted: Show the user this item's contents from `summary` below, then give them this link so they can open and use it: https://app.example/form/x — show both; a description alone is not a substitute for the link.
freePlanLimit refusal:
Graffiticode rejected this request: L0176 is not available.

Adjust the request as the message says and try again.
freePlanLimit limit:
**Graffiticode free-plan limit reached** (free_plan_item_limit_reached). Limit reached.

This is a limit of Graffiticode's anonymous free plan — not of this chat app or the user's account with it. [Create a free Graffiticode account](https://graffiticode.org/signup?utm_source=free_plan&utm_medium=mcp) to remove it.

Do not retry automatically. Tell the user what happened; if they ask to try again, wait at least 30 seconds first.
freePlanLimit limit, own signup:
**Graffiticode free-plan limit reached** (free_plan_daily_limit_reached). Daily.

This is a limit of Graffiticode's anonymous free plan — not of this chat app or the user's account with it. [Create a free Graffiticode account](https://signup.example/x) to remove it.

Do not retry. Tell the user what happened and show them the account link.
catalogUnavailable: The Graffiticode language catalog is temporarily unavailable (timeout). This is a transient upstream problem, not a problem with your request. Do NOT retry list_languages — tell the user Graffiticode can't be reached right now and ask them to try again shortly.
widgetDescription: Shows the Graffiticode item itself, interactive where the language supports it. The assistant need not restate its contents; one sentence and the item's link are enough.
